title: NBEMS Group A, B, C Various Post Admit Card 2026
organization: National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences
postName: NBEMS Group A, B and C Various Posts
vacancyDetails: 53 posts across the notified Group A, Group B and Group C categories.
selectionProcess: Written examination followed by the stages specified in the recruitment notice
documentsRequired: Printed admit card and valid original photo identity proof
howToApply:
1. Open the NBEMS admit-card login page.
2. Enter the required application or login details.
3. Download and print the admit card.
4. Check the exam date, centre and reporting instructions before travelling.
shortDescription: NBEMS Group A, B, C Various Post Admit Card 2026 is expected before the revised 15-16 September 2026 examination. Download the hall ticket from the official NBEMS-linked portal when available.
content:
National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS) is conducting the Group A, Group B and Group C Various Post examination under Advertisement No. A-12011/3/2025-Estb.

The revised examination is scheduled for 15 and 16 September 2026. Candidates who completed the application should use the official admit-card login page and verify the examination centre, reporting time and identity-document instructions before the exam.
